body: U+0023# 2026-10-03 (later): the regression is the glints; final apps installedU+000AU+000AU+002A*Sparkle probes on the Note 10+.** All were built from main a13cd6e4, with the Meadow seed pinned, the GPU uncapped (`thermal_pwrlevel` 0), and 10 s per case.U+000AU+000A| Build | Noon fps (raster p50) | Midnight fps | Marks per frame | Filtered draws per frame |U+000A|---|---|---|---|---|U+000A| main (counting) | 36.0 (28.5 ms) | 61.6 | 119 to 128 | 113 to 121 noon, 61 to 70 midnight |U+000A| no glare | 36.2 (28.3 ms) | 61.7 | 122 | 115 |U+000A| **no glints** | **61.6 (12.8 ms)** | 61.7 | 74 | 67 |U+000A| no marks at all | 61 to 62 (12.0 ms) | 61.7 | 0 | 0 |U+000AU+000AU+002D The roughly 50 glint draws per noon frame are the entire 16 ms. The other roughly 67 draws (glare, ripples, flows) cost under 1 ms.U+000AU+002D At midnight about 59 marks make no draw, because the glints shift with the moon off the water tiles.U+000AU+002D The total mark area is equal at noon and midnight (about 3,650 square world units), so size does not explain the cost.U+000AU+002D Only 4 or 5 draws per frame go through the clipped, split-across-tiles path, so clipping does not either.U+000AU+002D In the lab Mac VM every filtered draw costs about 1 ms, so the VM penalises all marks, not only the glints. On the phone, why glints cost about 0.3 ms each while flows cost about 0.01 ms is not yet explained; a GPU trace would say.U+000AU+002D The probe edits are `scratch/edit_area.py` (with `NO_GLARE` or `NO_GLINTS`) and `scratch/edit_countmarks.py`.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Pictures.** In `results/`, the live noon frames `phone/live-pclip` and `phone/live-pnoglint` show the glints as the trail of small light ovals under the sun's reflection on the lake. A still frame shows only the glare, because the glints are dim at that one instant.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Owner decisions.** The owner accepted 100% scale on both platforms (decision 01M42MNJJ2DT2X5GHWYFEASCRD; criterion 5 done).U+000AU+000AU+002A*Installs.** Every comparison and old test app is gone from the Note 10+ and the Mac (app copies and container data moved to `~/.Trash/field-notes-apps-2026-10-03/`; the empty container shells cannot be removed).U+000AU+002D Note 10+: `dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.plain` (seeded: 1,006 days, 643 entries, onboarding done, keep-moving on) and `.fresh` (never opened).U+000AU+002D Mac: `~/Applications/field_notes_plain.app` (seeded the same way) and `field_notes_fresh.app` (empty container).U+000AU+002D Both platforms' builds are from main a13cd6e4, kept in `~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-sweep/device/final/`. The device-pass `update_phone.zsh` now installs those builds.
